Thank you for your contribution!

Unfortunately, we are closing this pull request because it is not linked to an issue that has been discussed and approved by our product team.

Before opening a pull request that adds a feature or changes the UI, please first create an issue in [element-meta](https://github.com/element-hq/element-meta/issues) and wait for it to be approved by product (with the `X-Accepting-PRs` or `X-Accepting-PoC-PRs` label). See [Start with an issue](https://github.com/element-hq/element-meta/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#1-start-with-an-issue) for more details.

Once the issue has been approved, feel free to open a new pull request (or ask us to reopen this one) referencing it.
